identify all data processing, analysis, forecasting and Cyber Security requirements for the target systems to meet the expected business volumes and profitability with the promised quality of service

modules.module_title: Support and execute the intelligent implementation of the Industry 4.0 plan for the Industry

pcs.pc_description: create collaboratively, a modular partition of whole system as a system-of-systems, and further drill down to sub-systems (to required depth of details)

list technology options for each system and sub-system in the plan, identifying the already installed legacy systems, with their advantages and downsides
participate in collaborative finalization of the optimum technology mix – considering the overall business vision, costs, knowledge base, expertise and connected ecosystem

ensure that Cyber Security is built into each layer – device, connections, data, cloud, HMIs, controllers, applications, analytics, access control, physical security, partner connections and data sharing
include Cyber Security Risk Management Plan, together with Data Backup and Recovery, and Business Continuity Plan
get the finalized Blueprint of Industry 4.0 Plan for the organization, with clearly marked phases, timelines and capabilities added in each phase

pcs.pc_description: prepare detailed drawings and specifications of the system, drilling down to subsystems and components
prepare Bill of Materials (BOM) listing all equipment, controllers, drives, sensors, actuators, cables, accessories, and consumables
prepare process flow diagrams
prepare data flow diagrams and data structures
prepare list of vendors for different category of components
prepare list of third-party services for connectivity, messaging, data, and computing
prepare list of applications, software and Cyber Security tools needed

pcs.pc_description: participate in preparation of production plan following the organization goals and KPIs, using the organization specified application and tools. Ensure that all production facilities in a multifacility organization are involved in preparation of the plan
ensure that the plan includes Cyber Security and is consistent with the plant capacity and capability
ensure that customer inputs and requirements are included in the plan. Consult with customers if required
ensure that vendor capacities and capabilities are included in the plan
derive plan for each vendor and discuss with them to ensure viability
review plans and rework if required
confirm that the plan is adopted by the management and communicated to all concerned
ensure that the procurement plan is aligned with the production plan
participate in scheduling the production plan, using organization specified tools and applications
verify that the schedules generated for each line, system and equipment is consistent with their capacity
verify that the utilities and consumables are adequate for the product plan and schedule
verify that the workforce capacity and skills are adequate for the product plan and schedule
create Maintenance Plans (Predictive, Preventive) and Schedule for all critical systems and equipment
ensure availability of spares for critical systems and equipment
prepare skill development and training plan for the workforce to align with the production plan and available workforce
ensure adequate capacity for storage of in- process goods, finished goods, dispatch and logistics
ensure that the Quality Plan is consistent with the production plan
ensure that the Quality checks are built into the line and equipment schedules
ensure that Cyber Security checks are performed by experts and designed level of security is achieved
keep product design and PLM teams engaged in and provide feedback about the production and quality issues

modules.module_title: Conduct one-to-one interactions with different stake holders of the organization with the pre-defined goals, roles and responsibilities

pcs.pc_description: create daily, weekly, and periodic schedules of interaction with various teams that fall within the role definition in the organization as well as recommended by Industry 4.0 practices
respond to any query related to customer or vendor with priority
conduct regular rounds of production facility and ensure systems are running smoothly
watch for any signs of inefficiencies in equipment, operation or processes and identify possible causes
discuss issues with the production line with concerned people and find resolutions
review Cyber Security status and address issues, if any

modules.module_title: Help the team understand the entrepreneurial spirit of Industry 4.0 and adopt the systems

pcs.pc_description: keep the team engaged and ensure that they see the key features of Industry 4.0 and its value. Stress on utmost need for Cyber Security and their role in it
conduct regular talks, events, digital communications involving targeted / all workforce and management to highlight the success of Industry 4.0 adoption
identify any areas of the plant that are finding it difficult to adapt to Industry 4.0 culture and help to overcome it

ensure all stakeholders are involved in the process and have access to the applications and tools

ensure that the plan conforms with the capacity of the plant and partners’ capacity

ensure that appropriate Monitoring and Notifications Systems are in place and programmed with alerts so that any deviations are immediately communicated

modules.module_title: Use appropriate tools and methods for Agile / Flexible / Lean manufacturing

pcs.pc_description: apply Modular Product Design concept and tools for fast and easy variation
apply Information Technology to enable collaboration among planners, designers, procurers, and producers for fast response to orders and customizations
leverage Corporate Partners (sister organizations, vendors, strategic alliances with other companies) to improve time-to-market for key product areas
promote Knowledge Culture and employee training to facilitate rapid change and continuous adaptation

leverage use of Lean Processes – such as running small batches, customized one-offs using 3- D Printing, fast changeovers of models/versions, and a culture of continuous improvement rather than big-bang changes

modules.module_title: Contribute to Quality Management systems followed in the organization

pcs.pc_description: contribute to Quality Management systems and Standards such as ISO900X, Six Sigma, Lean Six Sigma, TQM, SPC, Kaizen etc. followed in the organization
participate in quality reviews and work with the teams on solving issues identified
ensure that quality systems are integrated in the production planning and monitoring plans
ensure that the quality system is integrated with those of vendors and partners
ensure that the organization has required visibility into the quality data and events generated by vendors’ and partners’ systems

modules.module_title: Perform Plant Health Monitoring and Management

pcs.pc_description: plan and schedule Preventive Maintenance of all equipment and lines
use captured data and data analysis tools to perform Predictive Maintenance
minimize impact of breakdown maintenance and unscheduled shutdowns by rescheduling and leveraging of unused machines and resources
explore use of Machine Learning tools to understand the failure mechanisms and dependencies
ensure that fire safety and personnel protection systems are in place and these systems are integrated into overall monitoring system
ensure that personnel safety barriers and interlocks are built into every area having automated machines, robotic systems, automated lines, and automated material handling systems
ensure that chemicals and gas handling and protection systems are in place and these systems are integrated into overall monitoring system
ensure that all regulatory requirements are complied
ensure that all regulatory inspections are performed timely and all certificates / licenses are current
ensure that all fire escapes and emergency exits are visibly marked and are unhindered
ensure that there is adequate marking of hazardous areas and there are audio visual alarms automatically triggered by any violations
ensure that events relating to fire, chemical hazards, and other disaster situations are immediately communicated to the concerned authorities inside and outside the organization
ensure that there are well known and understood SOPs for dealing with emergency situations
ensure that medical aid and emergency health services are planned and available at all hours when the plant runs
ensure adequate safety and health facilities for female employees
ensure adequate cleanliness, lighting, ventilation, temperature control, dust and other pollution, and acceptable noise levels throughout the plant

modules.module_title: Optimize production performance utilizing Tool Room

pcs.pc_description: plan Tool Room services to support the digital manufacturing lines and equipment, the maintenance, customization, and prototyping needs
get corporate approval and funds for the tool room plan and personnel
implement the tool room facilities
utilize tool room facilities to ensure performance of plant and equipment
utilize tool room to quickly turn around customized tools, jigs, fixtures, and accessories to enhance productivity
utilize tool room to quickly turn around emergency spare parts to minimize production downtimes
utilize tool room for rapid production of customized parts needed for customers
utilize tool room for rapid prototyping of new design ideas

modules.module_title: Perform optimal scheduling and programming of robotic tools and production line

pcs.pc_description: ensure that adequate numbers of trained workforce is available for programming, modifying and repurposing robotic tools
ensure that programming applications and tools are up-to-date and are linked to the scheduling system
include partner and vendor machines into scheduling algorithm, where applicable
prepare alternate schedules if partner or vendor machines become available
ensure that all scheduling constraints and conflicts are resolved

modules.module_title: Respond to issues on production line and provide resolution involving stakeholders

pcs.pc_description: consider if manual mode can be used safely to temporarily get around any inconsistencies on production lines and ensure it is disabled automatically by timeout or manually on completion of exception
ensure local manual override is disabled by default for safety, except in emergency condition
ensure all enable, disable, overrides and inconsistency events are logged and analyzed
reschedule machines and jobs in case of a breakdown of any robotic or automated machine, and include any unused resources to optimize disruption
resolve conflicts relating to parts availability, scheduling, quality, line blockage or breakdown by collaborating with all stakeholders

modules.module_title: Proactively monitor production line for performance and early signs of failure using data analysis tools

pcs.pc_description: collect real time machine data regarding parts processed, machine speed and other settings, processing times, setup times, environmental data, machine temperature, pressure, vibrations etc., consumables utilized, power consumption, and other relevant parameters
analyse the real time data to derive statistics about productivity, utilization, down times, power and utility consumption, and variation of these parameters with time and processing speeds
derive and compile data about performance, reliability, cost, and processing times of different machine for different parts, over the period
compare the observed performance of machines with specifications and understand the cause for any significant variations – resolve with vendor or take corrective action
use the compiled data to analyse and find patterns of performance degradation which can be linked to early signs of failure
use the results for Predictive Maintenance scheduling
create bench-mark parameter settings for each machine for optimal performance and minimized maintenance. Use this for machine scheduling

modules.module_title: Communicate with stakeholders and seek inputs for production line performance

pcs.pc_description: seek inputs proactively feedback on plant performance from operators, quality personnel, sales and marketing
communicate with stakeholders about plant health and performance and share specific actions taken to address any reported issues
seek inputs and feedback on product features and quality from customers and their voice - sales and marketing
analyse the inputs and categorize these for immediate and future considerations

determine the type of issue for inputs requiring immediate attention - quality, specifications, delivery, or support. Address in consultation with relevant groups and determine action plan and response
consult with design and PLM groups for inputs product features and customizations, and determine suitable action plan and response
maintain a log of all issues raised, change requests and action taken. Use this for finalizing product enhancement plans

modules.module_title: Communicate deviations from plan to all concerned and help in restoring normalcy

pcs.pc_description: analyse all deviations and perform root cause analysis (RCA) involving all groups
use data analysis to arrive at the origin of problem, time, and sequence of progression

determine the root cause being - machine design or specs, machine setting, machine operation, state of maintenance, programming fault, hardware fault, communication error, scheduling issue, other issue, or a combination
look for patterns of behaviour and event relationships
classify the patterns and determine the best approach for dealing with these situations
make required changes in machine usage, settings, programming, and scheduling to rectify the errors logged
verify that the changes work - and get concurrent of involved stakeholders. Finalize the changes as part of machine setup instructions or SOPs
document and communicate the action taken and recommendations for correct operation to all stakeholders

modules.module_title: Identify areas for improvement and communicate with management for adoption

pcs.pc_description: consolidate the observations and actions taken and determine if there are any candidates for follow-up as proposals for product enhancement, change, reconfiguration or for any change or upgrade of equipment or production line
create for each candidate proposal, a detailed report with analysis, impact, and business case and share with the management
follow-up on the proposals and provide additional inputs for decision making

investigate and fill the gaps, in case of missing information
include provisions for Cyber Security at each layer

use appropriate HMI devices for User Interaction
own the design and be responsible for its upkeep and upgradation

pcs.pc_description: refer to the interconnection documentation and verify that all devices and controllers are connected using specified cables and following recommended interconnection practices
ensure all interlocks and emergency devices are connected
use appropriate signal levels, communication protocols and software stacks to connect devices with controllers
ensure cyber security requirements are setup
verify integrity of all wiring, interconnections, signal handling and ensure that all inputs/outputs are functional and comply with specified limits

capture all Motor Control loops as independent loops or part of larger loops
perform loop testing and confirm integrity
document all safety interlocks, emergency controls and ensure that these are programmed correctly
document and share start-up, shutdown, and emergency procedures. Ensure that these are visibly displayed at appropriate places
capture connections, control procedures and programming of all material handling and material movement systems

address all issues observed during the tuning process and resolve to closure involving all stakeholder
document the results of performance tuning and the settings of all devices, controllers, and actuators - along with the limits and alarms. Share this information with all stakeholders
test for Cyber Security, using recommended tools and involving experts. Document results along with complete configuration

leverage machines and manufacturing processes available in the vendors’ plants
connect various CAM, CNC and other machines with the DCS or other controllers using appropriate cables and interfaces and verify correct handshake

integrate and apply robotic and personnel safety systems, interlocks, and emergency procedures

integrate RFID based material inflow / outflow systems in the plant with the DCS and production management systems

define Cyber Security standards and implementations in all layers

collaborate with IT organization to install, configure, connect, integrate, secure, manage and troubleshoot applications and services
implement any defined data validators using available software and applications
ensure all applications are configured to use appropriate data inputs and produce outputs in the desired formats
define if the analytics and machine learning applications will run in on-line or batch mode and design appropriate data feed, data extractors and aggregators, and batch processors

define and design ‘Trust’ systems and the required infrastructure
apply Cyber Security standards at all layers and across all organizations connected to the system

modules.module_title: Verify correct implementation of IIoT and validate data, processed information, and analysis for correctness

pcs.pc_description: collaborate with IT to ensure that the devices, applications, and data sources are programmed to acquire and process the data correctly
verify the range, units, and conversion factors of raw data
verify that the frequency of data acquisition is appropriate
verify that the raw data is stable within the limits of process dynamics. If the data is inherently noisy, consider using hardware or software filtering before consumption

verify that statistical processing of raw data (averaging, minima, maxima, median, standard deviation etc.) are appropriate for each sensor - whether the processing is done within the device or elsewhere
verify that the limits and alarms for process parameters and variables use appropriate type of data - raw or processed
verify the latency of data at consumption points (for example in process loops and alarm processors) and ensure that its impact on control loops is within acceptable limits
test and verify the performance of validators using simulated data
verify that each data mining and analysis application receives correct data and produces correct outputs - which are validated by experts and by specifically designed validator programs
ensure that the processed data and analysis results are available to consuming applications and users online
validate with the users that the processed information and analysis they receive are correct and discuss any anomalies with stakeholders to resolve the issue
ensure that applications and users receive messages, alerts and alarms as programmed and that they respond to the communication in the correct manner

modules.module_title: Verify Cyber Security compliance

pcs.pc_description: set up the ‘Trust’ infrastructure for testing
test for ‘ZERO-TRUST’ compliance using defined scenarios and test cases and verify compliance
test Cyber Security compliance in all layers – using appropriate tools and experts and involving required stakeholders
collaborate with partners to set up and test for ‘ZERO-TRUST’ compliance of the connected system and verify compliance
reprogram the ‘Trust’ infrastructure for normal operation with organization roles, authorizations, and authentication mechanisms
verify that the user and applications access perform as designed and security is complied with

modules.module_title: Respond to requests from stakeholders regarding production line performance, quality, customization, or scheduling issues

modules.module_title: Capture information requirements at various decision- making points

pcs.pc_description: capture key information needed for decision making and identify what primary data is needed to support this
confirm that the data acquisition systems are designed to capture the required primary data
identify secondary information required and its sources –whether internal to the organization or external

capture all sources and destinations of digital data in the organization, their formats, and interfaces – such as sensors, devices, controllers, and software applications that produce raw data or processed information
identify formats, interfaces, volume, and latency of secondary data
identify data aggregation and pre-processing requirements for all data – primary and secondary – accounting for maximum latency of real time and critical data
capture the need for data processing to extract or develop the identified key information.

capture all data/information consuming applications – software for plant control, production management and planning, predictive maintenance, data visualization, what-if analysis, pattern recognition and machine learning systems of the ‘cognitive’ nature.
determine the volume of data, need for storage, type and location of storage
determine requirements for real-time, on- demand and offline/batch processing
include considerations of Data Security at all interfaces and in all processing and consuming applications
capture requirements for Disaster Management and Business Process Continuity to support the organization goals

modules.module_title: Determine capability and flexibility required in the analysis software

pcs.pc_description: capture detailed functionality of each analysis software and one or more datasets needed. Functionality must be governed by some organization KPIs to ensure its use and value
define the processing in terms of aggregations, filtering, transformations, interpolations, intermediate storage, combining and iterations to be performed on the datasets and the resultant outputs.
determine if multilevel processing is needed on same or differing datasets with different values of computation variables and derived parameters
define if the processing logic required for each analytic function is fixed, flexible, customizable, or self-learning.
define the functional variability, flexibility, or self-learning requirements clearly in detail, with examples if possible
create use cases and sample scenarios for discussion within and outside the organization
Identify users and stakeholders for the analytic functions and get their inputs and concurrence for the defined and planned functions

modules.module_title: Identify and implement suitable software for analysis and decision-making

pcs.pc_description: explore the available open source and commercial software that match the functional requirements and use cases defined. Involve IT department and other experts in the organization
compare with practices in other industries in the domain and consult experts within and outside the organization including partners and application vendors

brainstorm and estimate the time and effort needed to achieve the desired expertise using any proven open source software or platforms, with available experience in the organization, and its impact on time to market
create inhouse team for viable open source route, involving IT department and other experts in the organization to develop expertise in the platform and demonstrate the use cases defined
consider engaging professionals with expertise in the candidate open source platform for development and support

evaluate the performance of open source implementation and perform deep technical assessment of security, usability, accuracy, reliability, and supportability of the application considering its potential use for critical decision making
prepare business case for acquisition of open source and commercial software applications and present to management
share the results of the open source evaluation, with value and risk assessment, to management and get their decision on open source vs commercial
get management approval for personnel and resources, and formalize the development team for approved open source platform, part of or complete solution
get approved software from vendors and schedule training program by the vendors

get hands on training in using the software, along with other users in the organization, in all aspects of the software installation, configuration, programming, data import and export, visualization, validation, access control, cyber security, locks, advanced features, plug-ins etc.
perform development and implementation on the approved platforms and do pilot runs

modules.module_title: Test and verify correct processing and analysis of data

pcs.pc_description: disable any automatic actions based on analytics use in the testing phase.
integrate the analysis software with the plant automation system and ensure that all devices, applications, and data sources are programmed to generate the required data feeds for analysis
perform test runs and visualize the results. Perform any reconfigurations and tuning needed to get the desired outputs

create variations in data streams by changing process variables if possible – otherwise let the analytics run normally for long enough period to experience data variations spanning the entire dynamic range of the control system – or a reasonable subset

observe and record the analytics outputs and validate its accuracy by manual analysis and experience of the process personnel. Specifically, validate if any control outputs recommended by the system are logical and correct
test the applications thoroughly, involving all stakeholders and to establish the required level of performance over extended time
perform Cyber Security audit and compliance
get approval of experts and stakeholders for use and possible on-line decision making
document benchmark data, configuration, and results for later use

modules.module_title: Ensure utilization of analyzed information in visualization and decision making

pcs.pc_description: monitor the performance of analytics and address any issues reported relating to interpretation, data errors, accuracy, or inconsistency
analyse the issue, involving the implementation team and determine the cause
perform any software reconfigurations or changes needed or address usage and interpretation issues through appropriate communication and training
ensure that the analytics results are used for decision making and the user are satisfied
seek inputs for further enhancements in analytics and feed these into development cycle

modules.module_title: Adhere to standard safety procedures of the organisation

pcs.pc_description: comply with general safety procedures and those for handling equipment, tools, chemicals, and hazardous material, as prescribed and followed in the organisation
remove finger rings or any other metal objects likely to interfere with the work
ensure that identification badge or any other object worn around the neck or on the clothing does not get caught in any rotating machine, or otherwise interfere with the work
use appropriate safety devices such as goggles, gloves, ear plugs, caps, ESD pins, covers, shoes, helmets etc. recommended for the work being performed
inform, escalate, or raise alarm about any suspicions, unaccounted hazardous material, devices, or other objects found in the premises
inform, escalate, or raise alarm about any breach of safety or security procedure in the organisation
help achieve zero accidents goals at work
avoid damage to sensitive electronic components due to negligence of ESD procedures
participate regularly in fire drills or other safety related workshops organised by the organisation

follow strictly all access control and perimeter safety procedures in designated factory areas such as robotic work stations, automated production lines, automated material movement and other potentially risky operations
ensure that other people follow all access control and perimeter safety procedures in designated factory areas and help avoid accidents
use emergency switches or other mechanisms of stopping a machine immediately in case any emergency situation has developed or about to happen
ensure that electrical equipment are properly grounded
follow Cyber Security guidelines and be vigilant at workplace
proceed to designated safe assembly area immediately on hearing fire alarm

modules.module_title: Follow healthy practices and posture

pcs.pc_description: wash hands and use sanitizers as recommended to prevent spread of diseases
follow common personal hygiene practices
maintain appropriate posture, especially in long hours of sitting or standing position and in handling heavy materials
participate in company organised health sessions such as exercises, games, yoga, physiotherapy, and other activities
handle heavy and hazardous materials with care, while maintaining appropriate posture, using suitable tools, and handling equipment such as trolleys, jacks, and ladders
learn and apply first aid devices available in the workplace
learn and apply safety and handling procedures for electrical shock and electrocution
learn and apply emergency medical help services
follow workplace decorum and avoid emotional outbursts or inappropriate language
prevent any harassment at workplace

modules.module_title: Practice waste management and recycling

pcs.pc_description: identify recyclable, non-recyclable, and hazardous waste generated in the workplace and comply with their disposal procedures
dispose non-recyclable waste and hazardous waste following recommended processes
deposit recyclable and reusable material at identified locations
support education and compliance of waste management processes

modules.module_title: Conserve material and resources

pcs.pc_description: identify ways to optimize usage of material and resources such as water, electricity, energy in various tasks, activities, and processes
check for spills and leakages of material in various tasks, activities, and processes and plug them
escalate the leakage issue to appropriate authority if needed
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines, and equipment and maintain them in good working condition to optimize efficiency and wastage
check if the equipment is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify or report any malfunctioning to the responsible agency

check for any odour, sparks, fumes, emission, unusual vibration, noise, or any other objectionable presence in the environment and take immediate corrective action followed by report to responsible agency
ensure electrical equipment are properly connected for use and are switched off when not in use
support education and compliance of resource conservation processes
